name: prism-callee
description: Run the automated Prism lifecycle through Callee subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Automated Prism lifecycle with Callee subagents.
interface.longDescription: Runs the Prism lifecycle through Callee subagents, collects approval through a Callee Human agent at the human gate, and stops only when approval is withheld, verification completes, or another blocking condition is hit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use /prism-callee:lifecycle to advance a Prism story automatically through the Callee Human-agent approval gate and the remaining prism/* lifecycle phases.
